palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Search for a matter, a page or an action, then press Enter.
palette.empty: No matches. Try a matter name, court or action.
palette.hints: ↑↓ to move, ↵ to open, esc to close

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work anywhere except while you are typing in a field.

today.description: Your hearings for the day, by court and hall.
today.empty: No hearings today. Forward a cause list to see your court day.
today.hint: When a cause list is forwarded, your hearings appear here by court and hall.

tomorrow.hint: Listings for the next court day appear here once cause lists arrive.

calendar.description: Upcoming court days at a glance.
calendar.hint: Hearings and deadlines from your matters fill in this calendar.

inbox.description: Captures that need you, are ready to send or are processing.
inbox.hint: Forwarded emails, voice notes and files that need a decision land here.

matters.empty: No matters yet. Import or add your first matter.
matters.hint: Matters are created from your cause lists, or added by hand.

briefs.empty: No briefs yet. A brief appears when a matter is listed.
briefs.hint: Each listed matter gets a one-page brief for the hearing.

obligations.description: Filings, copies and follow-ups that are due.
obligations.hint: Filings, copies and follow-ups from your hearings are tracked here.

drafts.hint: Drafts you start from a matter are kept here until they are filed.

memory.description: What CauseDeck has noted, for you to review.
memory.hint: Notes CauseDeck learns from your work wait here for your review.

people.empty: No people yet. Add a client or counsel.
people.hint: Clients and counsel are linked to the matters they appear in.

courts.empty: Choose your courts to get started.
courts.hint: Your forums decide which cause lists CauseDeck reads for you.

activity.hint: Every change in this workspace is listed here, with undo.

billing.hint: Fees and payments are tracked against each matter.

invoices.hint: Invoices you raise for a matter are listed here.

limitation.hint: Limitation periods are computed from the dates in your matters.

insights.empty: Not enough activity for insights yet.
insights.hint: Trends across your matters and court days appear here.

settings.description: Workspace profile, members, roles and privacy.
settings.hint: Workspace profile, members, roles and privacy settings are on the way.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.description: Something went wrong loading this page.

offline.message: You are offline. Showing saved data from {time}.

permissionDenied.title: No access
permissionDenied.message: You do not have access to this area.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: We could not find this page in this workspace.

account.title: Account
account.description: Passkeys, two-factor authentication, sessions and connected accounts.
account.hint: Passkeys, two-factor sign-in and sessions will be managed here.

signIn.title: Sign in to CauseDeck
signIn.pullLine: Every hearing, every deadline, ready before you reach court.
signIn.passkeyUnsupported: Passkeys are not supported on this browser.
signIn.terms: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
signIn.hosted: India-hosted. Your matter data never leaves India.

errors.sendFailed: We could not send the link. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: We could not sign you in. Try again in a moment.
errors.expired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to sign in.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.

magicLink.subject: Your CauseDeck sign-in link
magicLink.body: Use this link to sign in to CauseDeck. It expires in {minutes} minutes: {url}

invitation.subject: You are invited to a CauseDeck workspace
invitation.body: Use this link to join the workspace. It expires in {minutes} minutes: {url}

onboarding.title: Create your workspace
onboarding.description: Your matters, court days and people live in a workspace. You can belong to several and switch any time.

kindHint.solo: Your own practice. Invite juniors or clerks later if you need to.
kindHint.chamber: A shared workspace for an advocate's chamber, with seats for each member.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the workspace.
errors.nameInvalid: Use a name with at least one letter or digit.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to create a workspace.
errors.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.generic: Could not create the workspace. Please try again.

valid.title: Join {workspace}
valid.body: You have been invited to join {workspace} as {role}.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations last 7 days. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.body: The workspace withdrew this invitation. Ask the person who invited you if you still need access.

used.title: This invitation has already been used
used.body: Each invitation link works once. If it was you, the workspace is already in your switcher.

invalid.title: This invitation link is not valid
invalid.body: Check that you opened the full link from the email, or ask for a new invitation.

emailMismatch.title: This invitation is for a different email
emailMismatch.body: You are signed in as {email}, but this invitation was sent to another address. Sign in with the invited email to accept it.

invite.differentAccount: Sign in with a different account

errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to accept the invitation.
errors.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.generic: Could not accept the invitation. Please try again.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.description: Your saved work is safe. Try again, or go back to Today.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: You are offline. Saved court days and briefs remain available once synced.
